bio.text: Jeff Gordon, a Republican, has represented District 35 in the Connecticut State Senate since January 4, 2023, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
His career experience includes working as a physician, and he has volunteered as president of the Connecticut State Medical Society.
He was elected to Woodstock's Planning & Zoning Commission in 2007 and has volunteered as president of the Woodstock Education Foundation and treasurer of the Woodstock Agricultural Society.
